records.name: Timothy Karas
records.notes: Current Superintendent/President of Mendocino College, appointed in 2020, per Wikipedia and the college's own leadership page (title Superintendent/President).

records.name: Peter DeVries
records.notes: Founding president of Mendocino College when the district was formed in 1972. A gap of several intervening superintendent/presidents between DeVries and Karas (2020) could not be confirmed from available sources within this research pass; site search and web search were unavailable during this session.

records.name: Brian Kalk
records.priorTitle: Chief Research Officer, Energy and Environmental Research Center
records.notes: Selected March 31, 2026 by the ND State Board of Higher Education as BSC's new president after a national search; assumed office July 1, 2026. Confirmed as sitting president in BSC's August 19, 2026 news coverage.

records.name: Dan Leingang
records.priorTitle: Vice President for Operations/Chief Operating Officer
records.notes: Served as interim president during the 2025-2026 national search; was also a finalist for the permanent role but Brian Kalk was selected instead.

records.name: Brent Sanford
records.notes: Named interim president January 9, 2025 immediately following Douglas Jensen's retirement, before Dan Leingang took over as interim later in 2025.

records.name: Douglas Jensen
records.notes: President 2020 to his retirement on January 2, 2025. Predecessor Dr. Larry C. Skogen served 2006-2020.

seats.university: Blue Ridge Community and Technical College

records.name: Unknown / not confirmed
records.notes: The college's website was persistently unreachable (403/503 errors) during this research session and Wikipedia has no dedicated leadership section, so the current president could not be confirmed. Web search was also unavailable (session budget exhausted). Needs follow-up research directly against blueridgectc.edu or the WV Community and Technical College System (wvctcs.edu).

records.name: George Timmons
records.priorTitle: Provost and Senior Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: HCC's fifth president; began the role in 2023 and was formally inaugurated April 19, 2024.

records.name: Christina Royal
records.notes: First woman to serve as HCC president; served 2017-2023 (Wikipedia lists her start as 2016).

records.name: William F. Messner
records.notes: President 2004-2016.

records.name: David M. Bartley
records.priorTitle: Speaker of the Massachusetts House of Representatives
records.notes: HCC alumnus and former Massachusetts House Speaker; served as president 1975-2004.

records.name: Joe Schaffer
records.notes: Ninth president of LCCC since it opened in 1968; serving since 2012 per the college's own presidential history page.

records.name: Miles LaRowe
records.notes: Interim president in 2011 between Darrel Hammon and Joe Schaffer.

records.name: Darrel L. Hammon
records.notes: President 2006-2010.

records.name: Charles H. Bohlen
records.notes: President 1992-2006.

records.name: Carla Tweed
records.notes: Current President of Coalinga College (West Hills College Coalinga), part of the West Hills Community College District. Exact start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources this session; web search was unavailable.

records.name: Bonnie Baerwald
records.notes: Current president of Moraine Park Technical College; began career as a Grant Thornton auditor before transitioning to higher education in 1993. College achievements cited under her leadership date back to at least 2016 (employee engagement tracking begins 2016), suggesting a tenure of a decade or more, but an exact start year and named predecessor could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: Thomas Mills
records.notes: Dr. Thomas Mills is confirmed as Hill College's current president via the college's own homepage. Exact start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed from available sources this session; web search was unavailable and the college's dedicated president bio pages returned 404 errors.

records.name: Steve Tiger
records.notes: Named Tulsa Tech's Superintendent and CEO on June 25, 2012, per the district's own leadership page. Prior role and predecessor superintendent could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: Lonnie Roberts
records.priorTitle: Acting President of Altamaha Technical College (ATC) and Coastal Pines Technical College (CPTC) Provost
records.priorInstitution: Coastal Pines Technical College / Altamaha Technical College
records.notes: Named President of Coastal Pines Technical College effective February 1, 2021, per the college's own website, after having served as Acting President of Altamaha Technical College (one of the two colleges that merged in 2014 to form Coastal Pines) and as CPTC Provost.

records.name: Lizette Navarette
records.notes: Appointed President of Woodland Community College (part of the Yuba Community College District) in December 2023, per the college's own leadership page. Previously Executive Vice Chancellor at the CA Community Colleges Chancellor's Office overseeing finance and facilities across the state's 73 districts.

records.name: Artemio Pimentel
records.notes: Listed as Woodland Community College's president on Wikipedia (likely reflecting the period before Navarette's December 2023 appointment); exact tenure years could not be independently confirmed this session.

records.name: Cynthia E. Spiers
records.priorTitle: Senior leadership roles (18 years) at Rhodes State College
records.notes: Confirmed as the fourth president of Rhodes State College (formerly Lima Technical College) via the college's own website; had already spent 18 of her 29 years in higher education in senior leadership roles at the college before becoming president. Exact start year and the names of the first three presidents could not be confirmed this session.

records.name: Torence Powell
records.notes: Appointed Chancellor by the Los Rios Board of Trustees (announced January 14, 2026); the district's tenth chancellor, assuming office July 2026. Previously Superintendent/President of Napa Valley College (2022-2026); earlier held Associate Vice Chancellor of Instruction and interim VP roles within Los Rios, and Dean at Cosumnes River College.

records.name: Brian King
records.notes: Chancellor immediately preceding Torence Powell; previously served as president of Cabrillo Community College in Aptos, CA. Exact end date/reason for departure not independently confirmed this session.

records.name: Carole Goldsmith
records.notes: Current Chancellor of State Center Community College District (Fresno City College, Reedley College, Clovis Community College, Madera Community College). Start year is an approximation based on general background knowledge; the district's chancellor page was not reachable (403) this session for direct confirmation of exact date, prior role, or predecessor.

records.name: Gregory A. Smith
records.notes: Confirmed via the district's own website as SDCCD's seventh chancellor, starting February 2024.

records.name: Carlos O. Turner Cortez
records.notes: Chancellor 2022 until his death in office in 2023, based on general background knowledge; not independently re-confirmed this session due to search limitations.

records.name: Constance M. Carroll
records.notes: Long-serving chancellor 2004-2021, based on general background knowledge; not independently re-confirmed this session due to search limitations.

records.name: Wolde-Ab Isaac
records.notes: Still listed as RCCD's sitting chancellor on the district's own chancellor page and was named Educator of the Year in a district article dated January 31, 2025. However, RCCD's homepage carried a 'RCCD Searches for the Next Chancellor' story dated July 21, 2026, indicating a search for his successor is underway as of this research date (Aug 2026); no successor had been announced as of this session. Start year and prior role are based on general background knowledge and were not independently re-confirmed this session.

records.name: Juan Salgado
records.notes: Chancellor of City Colleges of Chicago since 2017, confirmed via Wikipedia and the district's chancellor page; previously led Instituto del Progreso Latino as CEO from 2001-2017. A 2015 MacArthur Fellow.

records.name: Cheryl Hyman
records.notes: Chancellor prior to Salgado; oversaw initiatives including the College to Careers program (2011) and Chicago Star Scholarship (2014). Approximate end year based on Salgado's 2017 start.

records.name: Nelvia M. Brady
records.notes: First African-American and first woman to serve as City Colleges of Chicago chancellor, 1988-1992.

records.name: Marvin Martinez
records.notes: Appointed Chancellor of Rancho Santiago CCD (Santa Ana College and Santiago Canyon College) in July 2019, per the district's own website. Previously President of East Los Angeles College, and earlier President of Los Angeles Harbor College, Provost of Santa Monica College, and Dean of Business and Industry at Cerritos College.

records.name: Raul Rodriguez
records.notes: Believed to be a predecessor chancellor of RSCCD based on general background knowledge, with an interim period preceding Martinez's 2019 appointment; not independently confirmed this session as the district's leadership history pages were not reachable.
